acceptance: PROVISIONAL; full raster and browser verified, regional limitations remain
limitations: Nine independent checks give RMS 65.42 m, median 60.16 m, P95 100.67 m and maximum 114.61 m. The 100 m RMS ceiling passes; northern mainland edges, parcel interiors and unmeasured minor islands remain provisional.
Goat/Burying Island and White Head Island each supply one control and a separate endpoint check, so these local samples are spatially correlated.

Southern Cranberry Island retains a recognizable southern tip but the historical whole outline is now represented by separated modern fragments; working source uncertainty is 18 px for that check, 12 px elsewhere.
